description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Frontline Strategist, adding {W}.
When Frontline Strategist dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Frontline Strategist from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Frontline Strategist's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
